_format: Global catalog of REAL painted doors per tile, replacing hand-guessed continuous positions. Keys are the side= value from tiles.ini. artGrid is [cols, rows] on the ART grid (1 unit = 1024/3 px, confirmed 2026-08-19 against real annotated in-game screenshots -- see references/doors.md). Each door entry is {col, row, wall}: col/row are 0-indexed ART-grid cell coordinates, UNROTATED (the tile as drawn, rotation=0). `wall` (north/south/east/west) is a DOCUMENTARY label describing the door's position in that original unrotated drawing ONLY -- it is derived from row/col (row 0 = north, last row = south, col 0 = west, last col = east) and MUST NOT be used directly to decide where a door ends up once a tile is placed with rotation != 0. Placement code must always go col,row -> local unrotated engine offset -> rotate (geometry.md's table) -> add the tile's anchor. See scripts/door_position.py and references/doors.md 'Two grids' section.
